items.stem: A control chart shows all points within limits and no pattern. The process is best described as:

options.text: In statistical control with only common-cause variation
options.rationale: Correct: an in-control chart with no pattern reflects common-cause variation.

options.text: Out of control and needing immediate reaction
options.rationale: No signal means no special cause to react to.
Control status is separate from capability.
In-control does not guarantee all parts meet spec.

items.explanation: Correct: an in-control chart with no pattern reflects common-cause variation.

items.stem: The main reason to run a measurement systems check before analysing process data is to:

options.text: Confirm the data reflects the process, not measurement error
options.rationale: Correct: an inadequate gauge adds noise that masks the true process.

options.text: Increase the number of data points
options.rationale: A measurement check does not add data points.

items.explanation: Correct: an inadequate gauge adds noise that masks the true process.

options.rationale: Correct: the mean is a measure of central tendency.

Range measures spread, not central tendency.
